title: ScadaUtilityInstruction
description: Simulated utility/ISO -> orchestrator, published on <root>/scada/instruction/<bank_id>, QoS 1. An L2 hard constraint (K5, G-15) -- never traded for commercial value.

limit_kw.description: Required and >=0 when kind == LIMIT; null otherwise.

lifts_instruction_id.description: On a lift (expires_at <= issued_at): the instruction_id of the instruction this lift ends. A utility-initiated stop is released only after the utility's lift names the instruction that engaged it, then the operators' two-person release (Q10).
